first.text: What follows is a true story although there will almost certainly come a moment in this film where you will doubt that it is a true story and I can promise you there have been times when I wished it wasn't.... But it is and...

plot: In this crime drama, four bright and well-off college students in Kentucky plot to steal some rare books from their university's Special Collections Library in a misguided quest for personal glory. Based on the story, the film includes interviews with the foursome who attempted the bizarre heist. Starring Barry Keoghan, Evan Peters, Blake Jenner, Jared Abrahamson and Ann Dowd.
